name: Outbreak
description:
A mod about physiology, disease, drugs and contagion: infections and the immune response that fights them, fever and body temperature, water, electrolytes and iodine, and the willow bark soup and dexamethasone that treat it all.
关于生理、疾病、药物与传染的模组：感染与免疫反应、发烧与体温、水量 / 电解质 / 碘，以及用来治疗它们的柳树皮汤与地塞米松。
